newsitem.title: USA: Health and Retirement active after offering.
newsitem.headline: Health and Retirement active after offering.

text.p: Health and Retirement Properties Trust shares were the most active stock on the New York Stock Exchange with over three million shares trading hands in the first few minutes of trading after the company completed an offering of 23.5 million shares.

The shares were priced at at $18-7/8 for the offering, according to lead underwriter Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette. Other managers of the very large offering were A.G. Edwards, Merrill Lynch, NatWest Securities, PaineWebber, Prudential Securities, Salomon Brothers and Smith Barney.
The size of the offering was raised from an original estimate of 22 million, according to the underwriter.
